user.title: GCE RfPlayer
user.description: Choose how to connect to the RFPlayer.

error.device_missing: Unable to connect to the specified device
error.multiple_device: Select either a serial device or an IP address/port.

discover_rf_devices.title: Discover sensors
discover_rf_devices.description: Listen for sensors that transmit an RF event. You can add a detected sensor or replace an existing sensor if its RF ID changed.

finish_discovery.title: Listening for sensors
finish_discovery.description: Transmit from the sensor now, then continue within 60 seconds to review detected sensors.

replace_device.title: Replace RF device
replace_device.description: Map this detected ID to an existing device to keep its entities and history.

data.automatic_add: Add device automatically when signal received
data.init_commands: Comma-separated list of commands executed at startup

add_rf_device.title: Add RF device manually
add_rf_device.description: Enter a device's protocol, address, and profile manually. Use this for devices that transmit infrequently or are quiet when you configure them.

data_description.send_pairing_command: Put the device in pairing mode first. The RfPlayer then sends an ASSOC command so the device learns this address. Only available for protocols the RfPlayer can transmit.

error.incompatible_protocol: Protocol and device profile are incompatible
error.invalid_address: Address must be a positive integer, a X10 address (e.g. A1) or an hexadecimal value prefixed with x (e.g. xBEEF)
error.no_receiver_protocol: At least one receiver protocol must be selected
error.pairing_not_supported: The RfPlayer cannot send pairing commands with this protocol
error.cannot_connect: RfPlayer is not connected: the pairing command could not be sent
error.duplicate_redirect: This detected ID is already assigned to another device
error.duplicate_device: A device with this protocol and address is already configured

abort.no_devices_found: No supported RF devices were detected
abort.no_compatible_devices: No compatible existing device was found

send_raw_command.name: Send command
send_raw_command.description: Send a command to RF device.

send_pairing_command.name: Send pairing command
send_pairing_command.description: Send a pairing command to a RF device.

address.name: Address
address.description: Device address. Do not use X10-form (e.g. 1 instead of A2).
